title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the SQL Profiler save and load functions in the PEM web application do not keep…
description: A vulnerability in Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) allows users with the SQL Profiler role to read and overwrite files outside their designated storage directory via the SQL Profiler save and load functions. This can lead to overwriting the PEM web application's configuration database, causing a denial of service for all users. Starting from PEM version 10.6.1, this issue is mitigated by restricting file operations to the user's storage directory.
